trust_decision.summary: Whether a third-party reflective bean library may call c3p0's live-connection getters is decided by java.beans.Introspector over the compiled DataSource/ConnectionPoolDataSource classes (no explicit BeanInfo exists in the pinned tree); the published fix moves that decision into build-generated BeanInfo that hides property names `connection`/`pooledConnection` and property types java.sql.Connection / javax.sql.PooledConnection.

landing_point.why: The advisory says c3p0 composes with other libraries into a gadget sink; ComboPooledDataSource is the flagship public bean users deploy and the class the project's own bean-comparison test drives, so an engineer starts by asking which bean properties it exposes.

fix_sites.entry_point: build-time only: new class C3P0BeanInfoGen with main(String[] fqcn..., outDir), run by the mill `beanInfo` target; its output makes java.beans.Introspector.getBeanInfo(...) omit `connection`/`pooledConnection` for 9 named bean classes
fix_sites.module_kind: new `beanInfo` build module (code generator; no runtime code added)

fix_sites.entry_point: mill build graph: `beanInfo`/`beanInfoBin` module definitions, the beanInfoGen task, the overridden `jar` task and the extended test runClasspath

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The unprotected sites are abstract base/filter classes and a test-only copy, so a gadget can never instantiate them by name; every concrete DataSource it could name is on the published list.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The settable `connectionPoolDataSource` property (type javax.sql.ConnectionPoolDataSource) and the `connectionTesterClassName` / `connectionCustomizerClassName` properties must stay introspectable: they configure the nested CPDS and are encoded into the JNDI Reference. An exclusion keyed on a `connection*` name prefix, or on 'any javax.sql type', silently drops them, breaking PoolBackedDataSource setup and Reference round-trip; removing or renaming getConnection() would break the javax.sql.DataSource contract instead.

O6_input_shapes: read-only property named `connection`, synthesised by Introspector from getConnection() on DataSource implementations
read-only property named `pooledConnection`, synthesised from getPooledConnection() on ConnectionPoolDataSource implementations
property type java.sql.Connection (type-based exclusion catches a Connection-typed property under any name)
classes that only inherit the offending getter (ComboPooledDataSource, PoolBackedDataSource, debug.CloseLogging/ConstructionLogging/AfterCloseLoggingComboPooledDataSource)
a package-private implementation (JndiRefForwardingDataSource), whose BeanInfo must still be generated into its package

O8_uncovered_routes.route: public abstract base AbstractComboPooledDataSource (Serializable, Referenceable) inherits getConnection() from AbstractPoolBackedDataSource, so it and any user subclass still expose the `connection` property; no BeanInfo is generated for it
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: abstract, so it cannot be the object a gadget instantiates; the concrete ComboPooledDataSource is covered
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 1 file / 2 packages (com.mchange.v2.c3p0 -> com.mchange.v2.c3p0.impl) from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: second DataSource implementation in another package: FilterDataSource.getConnection() introspects as property `connection` and is not in the generator's class list
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: abstract thin delegate with no settable properties, so it is not a bean a deserializer can populate
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 3 files / 2 packages from the landing point (com.mchange.v2.c3p0 -> .impl -> .filter)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: concrete public DataSource test copy FreezableDriverManagerDataSource keeps the `connection` property; the published fix deliberately leaves it commented out of its class list
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: test sources, not shipped in the jar, and the fix's argv list has it commented out (fix.diff:127)
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different source root (test/src), 2 packages from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a getConnection()/getPooledConnection() accessor added to the JBoss / MBean facade, mirroring ComboPooledDataSource
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the class already mirrors dozens of ComboPooledDataSource getters (e.g. :125, :179) and is a public MBean surface a maintainer would naturally extend with connection accessors

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a Connection-typed cached property added to a beangen schema, which the name/type blacklist must still catch
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: bean properties are added by editing these XML schemas, and the fix's type-based exclusion is what silently covers a schema-added Connection property

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another property-name -> readMethod map that invokes introspected getters on a user-supplied DataSource
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the project already builds exactly such a map here and reads `userOverridesAsString` through it (:358), so a sibling helper reading a connection-producing getter would look idiomatic

O9_family: CWE-502 deserialization of untrusted data / reflective bean-property (getter) composition into a JNDI-lookup or connection-acquiring sink

O10_build.toolchain: mill 1.0.6 on JDK 11 (build.mill:1-2), javac -source/-target 7 (build.mill:41-45); Maven deps incl. mchange-commons-java 0.6.0-SNAPSHOT (mill-build/build.mill:9), which is not on Maven Central and must be pre-seeded or locally published; test module adds junit-vintage 5.10.2 and postgresql 42.6.0 (build.mill:320-326)
services: PostgreSQL at localhost:5432 only for the DB-backed tests (build.mill:328); the deserialization/bean tests in this area need no database
O10_build.project_tests: test/src/com/mchange/v2/c3p0/test/junit/DeserializationGadgetMitigationsJUnitTestCase.java (states at :31-33 that it needs no running database) and MarshallUnmarshallDataSourcesJUnitTestCase.java (bean and Reference round-trip via BeansUtils.equalsByAccessibleProperties, :85-102). No pinned test asserts the introspected property set, and the test the fix's own comment names (PerishableConnectionResourcesNotBeanPropertiesJUnitTestCase, fix.diff:172) exists in neither the pinned tree nor the fix diff.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Suppress bean properties by `connection*` name prefix (or by 'all javax.sql types') for the obvious public classes only, which either strips the legitimate connectionPoolDataSource / connectionTesterClassName properties or leaves the debug-package subclasses and abstract bases exposed.

out_of_scope_notes: src/com/mchange/v2/c3p0/impl/SetManagedDatabaseMetaData.java:19 also turns getConnection() into a `connection` property, but the class is package-private and is not a DataSource/ConnectionPoolDataSource, so it is outside this advisory's protection.

The JNDI-name guard at src/com/mchange/v2/c3p0/JndiRefForwardingDataSource.java:86-96 and the ObjectFactory whitelist are existing defences for neighbouring gadget routes; they were not changed by this fix and were not assessed further.
unverified: The fix needs com.mchange.v2.codegen.bean.BeanInfoGen from mchange-commons-java 0.6.0-SNAPSHOT; that library is a snapshot dependency (mill-build/build.mill:9) whose source is not in this repo, so whether BeanInfoGen is present in the pinned dependency and whether the build resolves offline could not be checked.
Repo size was not measured (no shell in this session); the tiny_repo flag rests on 157 .java files / 233 tracked files, not on a byte measurement.

The external library or libraries that actually compose with c3p0 (the advisory's 'other libraries') are not in this repo; only in-repo evidence was read (Introspector use, BeansUtils property comparison).
No build or test run was performed, so the buildability claim is from build.mill only; mill 1.0.6 and the Maven artifacts must be available in the image.

The published fix contains no runtime source change (a build-time generator plus mill wiring), so any hidden behavioural test must run against the built classes with the generated BeanInfo on the classpath; a solver whose fix works but is not wired into the test classpath would fail for mechanical reasons.
Whether the fix's generated BeanInfo reaches classes loaded by a plain `mill build.test` run in this image was not verified.
